Chapter one

Our Story

Two families, one long conversation that started over iced coffee and never really ended.

2019

The first meeting

A mutual friend’s birthday in Toul Kork. Dara spent the evening pretending he wasn’t nervous; Sophea noticed immediately and let him carry on.

2022

Kep, at low tide

Three days by the sea, one borrowed motorbike, and the quiet understanding that neither of them wanted to go home alone.

2025

The families met

Tea, fruit, and a long list of auspicious dates. The elders settled on February before either of them had finished a cup.

The ceremonies

Wedding Programme

A traditional Khmer wedding, in the order the day unfolds. You are warmly welcome to any part of it — and to all of it.

What to wear

Daytime ceremonies: traditional Khmer dress, or formal wear in soft colours. Evening reception: formal. Guests are asked to avoid white and black as the main colour.

Gifts

Your presence is the gift. For those who wish to follow custom, an envelope may be given to the family at the reception table.
